title: feat(history): undo/redo grouping with isolated table edits

commits.message:
feat(history): expose newGroupDelay and minDepth grouping options

Lets hosts tune undo granularity (or disable time-based merging with delay 0) via createHistoryPlugin({ newGroupDelay, minDepth }), wiring through to CodeMirror's history() config.

feat(live-preview): isolate structural table edits as undo groups

Structural table operations (add/delete/move column or row, range clear) rewrite the whole table source in one dispatch; tag each with isolateHistory('full') so a single undo reverts the entire operation instead of merging with adjacent typing or another structural edit. Cell text input keeps default time-based grouping.
